# `layout/legendModel`

A legend line is a title, a vertical position and its entries; an entry is a label, a
colour and an already-formatted value. Modelling it as data is what lets the legend be rendered,
tested and asserted without a canvas.

## Example

```ts
import type { LegendLine } from 'lightweight-magic-charts';

export const line: LegendLine = {
  id: 'price',
  title: 'Price action',
  topPx: 8,
  entries: [{ id: 'close', label: 'Close', color: '#4c8dff', value: '101' }],
};
```

## Exports

- **`LegendEntry`** · type · `interface LegendEntry { id: string; label: string; color: string | null; value: string }`
- **`LegendLine`** · type · `interface LegendLine { id: string; title: string; topPx: number; entries: readonly LegendEntry[] }`
